source.title: Collection of Aramaic Terracotta Incantation Bowls — lot 1200
source.citation: Apollo Art Auctions, Fine Ancient Art and Antiquities, 21 June 2026, lot 1200, LiveAuctioneers item 232753114.

default_claims.value_text: Group components reportedly 175–200 mm × 50–75 mm; individual assignment unavailable
Private UK collection; purchased on the London art market in the 1980s

entries.notes: First separately visible physical bowl in a three-bowl lot; flaring form, rounded base, spiral interior text.
Second separately visible physical bowl in a three-bowl lot; flaring form, rounded base, spiral interior text.
Third separately visible physical bowl in a three-bowl lot; one component stands on a ring foot, but the public description does not map that feature to an ordinal.
